# Network360 Core Team

With this release, the Network360 Core Team improved the security profile of the Netowrk360 platform and implemented tech upgrades.  This release also includes various fixes in the Compare Networks, Model Networks, Administration, and Accessibility modules.  

## Fixes

### Accessibility

Now when a user navigates from Accessibility to Create a Directory by clicking on the linked Provider Counts in the results, the breadcrumbs retain the navigation path from Accessibility to Create a Directory so the user can seamlessly navigate back to their Accessibility analysis.   This fix will be useful for clients with the Create a Directory and Accessibility feature permissions. 



### Compare Networks PDF Export 

Fixed an issue when a blank page appeared within the pdf export when many networks or geographies were part of the analysis criteria. 

### Model Networks (Network Builder and Optimization Tool) 

Now in Model Networks when searching for a provider to add to a model network using the Affiliation > Admitting Privileges criteria, the user now sees results (a list of providers) instead of an error message.
